name: Shoichi Urata
source: Siberian Husky high school senior and Yuuichi's childhood best friend. He is not only the star of the school volleyball team but also one of the best setters in Japan; moreover, he is the student council president, president of his class, and an exemplary student. He wants nothing more than to play volleyball professionally — a dream obstructed only by his being pragmatic to a fault, as well as his complicated relationships with his family.
